struct MoveInfo has no healing-amount member in this fork; "healing" is emitted as null for every move - heal fractions live in battle scripts, not in the move table

ABILITY_LIBERO sets no .aiRating; C zero-initialises it, so 0 is the compiled value rather than an unrated ability
struct ItemInfo in this fork has no registrability field (upstream dropped it for .importance); registrability is null on every item
22 TM slots exist as bag items but are absent from FOREACH_TM, so they teach MOVE_NONE
1 species have no .teachableLearnset pointer; their tm/hm/tutor lists are empty by construction, not by omission
1 species have no .levelUpLearnset pointer
6 wild tables whose label lacks "FireRed" are never compiled (abandoned drafts); not joined to any map
1 script labels are defined twice; the first definition was used for the trainer join
5 map folders are in no map group, so the ROM never contains them; emitted with inBuild false
Kanto maps use MAPSECs this hack appended after KANTO_MAPSEC_END, so their regionMapSectionInKantoRange is false though the map is Kanto
141 tables compile under "#if defined EMERALD" and are absent from the FireRed build; 6 of them are hand-written Kanto drafts whose label ends in "Frlg" instead of "FireRed" (confirmed abandoned)
134 tables compile under "#if defined LEAFGREEN" only

these maps carry more than one live table; GetCurrentMapWildMonHeaderId returns the first match, and its VAR_ALTERING_CAVE_WILD_SET escape hatch tests MAP_ALTERING_CAVE (a Hoenn map), so only variantIndex 0 is reachable in the FireRed build

pool 1 is referenced by a script but sLegendaryPool{n} was not found
pool 2 is referenced by a script but sLegendaryPool{n} was not found
22 name(s) in the party file are not spelled the way the game names them (written as constants, or without the game's punctuation); the display names were taken from the constants
no trainer in the party file declares an Items line, so every items[] is empty by source, not by extraction failure
no mon declares Dynamax Level or Gigantamax; both are null throughout and the ROM default MAX_DYNAMAX_LEVEL applies
54 mons carry no Level line and take trainerproc's default of 100
152 mons list no moves; the ROM fills their moveset from the species learnset at battle setup, so no moveset can be shown
188 mons list no Ability; trainerproc emits no .ability and the species default applies
these trainers use the gym-leader class but are not named as Kanto leaders; bossKind is a best-effort derivation and is expected to be re-tagged by hand
